title: Fort Dearborn monument: the warrior's sash and its hanging cloth
items: On the Fort Dearborn monument (18th Street, 1904), the warrior now wears the broad sash both photographs show wrapped round his hips, sloping down to his right hip, with its fringed ends flying out to the west. Before, he had only a thin belt and a narrow strip of cloth.
The cloth hanging from the sash falls dark at his right hip and beside his raised thigh, as in the photographs.
